name: 轻薄冰糖条
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE horizontal game UI progress-meter design on a true transparent background, for the same bright cute bubble-shooter game as reference image 1. Image 1 is the CURRENT GAME style/context reference; image 2 is the latest milk-white dialog material reference. Do not redraw the screenshot. Output ONLY the new progress meter, front-facing, horizontal, no perspective, no scene. Soft rounded candy/glass illustration, controlled small upper-left highlights, smooth cel shading, clean silhouette. This is informational UI, quieter than the big action buttons. Progress fill must show exactly about 68 percent of the usable track, empty remainder 32 percent; blue fill ends in a smooth round cap, clear boundary. No sparkling hotspot at fill endpoint, no stars, characters, particles, decorative bubbles floating outside, stripes, ticks, milestones or extra icons. NO TEXT and NO NUMERALS: a live percent label will be added separately. Thin shapes should remain crisp at normal phone HUD scale. Do not include several variants or multiple meters. Generous transparent empty canvas around the single fully visible asset is fine.
Design A: a SINGLE thin frosted-glass capsule track, very slender 266:26 width-to-height proportion. The track itself is the whole component: NO larger outer enclosing plaque, NO second nested capsule. Milk-white subtly translucent empty track, restrained pale blue edge about 1 px at intended 266×26 size, faint narrow lower-edge shadow. Inside, progress fills 68% with clear sky-blue jelly, light cyan upper plane and slightly deeper azure lower plane, a thin soft upper highlight. Fill almost full track height with just about 2 px inset. Empty remainder is pale icy-white, unmistakably distinct from the fill. Simplify the material: no broad white reflection streak, no bulbous ends, no neon rim or thick bevel. No percent badge at either end; the percentage will sit outside this bar in the final composition. Overall airy and light.
layout_refinement: Percent fixed inside the right end of the single track after reviewing its contrast against the castle background.

It stays FIXED at the track's far right, not on the moving fill endpoint. Make the bubble light and legible, not a giant button. No text or numerals anywhere.
